title: FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit — Draw Terms Schedule
content:
Draws on FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit are governed by the following tier terms.

## Periods

| Tier | Draw period (months) | Repayment period (months) |
|---|---|---|
| FlexLine Starter | 36 | 36 |
| FlexLine Standard | 36 | 36 |
| FlexLine Plus | 48 | 48 |
| FlexLine Preferred | 48 | 48 |
| FlexLine Premier | 60 | 60 |
| FlexLine Elite | 60 | 60 |

*Draw period*: Whole calendar months from the open date during which draws are allowed. *Repayment period*: Months over which the balance at the end of the draw period is repaid in level payments.

## Draw size, frequency and fees

| Tier | Smallest draw (USD) | Most drawn in one calendar day (USD) | Most draws per billing cycle | Draw fee (% of each draw) | Minimum draw fee (USD) | Business days to funding |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FlexLine Starter | 100 | 1000 | 4 | 3.0 | 5.00 | 1 |
| FlexLine Standard | 100 | 2500 | 4 | 2.5 | 5.00 | 1 |
| FlexLine Plus | 250 | 5000 | 6 | 2.0 | 5.00 | 1 |
| FlexLine Preferred | 250 | 7500 | 6 | 1.0 | 5.00 | 1 |
| FlexLine Premier | 500 | 10000 | 8 | 0.0 | 0.00 | 0 |
| FlexLine Elite | 500 | 15000 | 8 | 0.0 | 0.00 | 0 |

Column meanings, as defined for the product: Smallest draw, USD. Most that may be drawn in one calendar day, USD. Most draws per billing cycle (integer). Draw fee as a percent of each draw. Minimum draw fee per draw, USD; 0.00 where there is no draw fee. Business days after the draw request until funds reach the bank account (0 = same business day when requested by the cutoff).

## Terms common to all six tiers

- **Same-day cutoff**: 14:00 Eastern Time — the Eastern Time cutoff for a draw to be funded the same business day where same-day funding applies (HH:MM).
- **Channels**: online, mobile app and phone — the channels through which a draw can be requested.
- **Phone draw fee**: 0.00 USD — the extra fee for a draw taken by a representative by phone.
- **Over-limit fee**: 0.00 USD — fee for exceeding the credit limit, USD (draws above available credit are refused instead).

## Notes on the funding column

A tier showing 0 business days funds a draw the same business day when it is requested by 14:00 Eastern Time; a tier showing 1 funds it one business day after the request. As a hypothetical example, a FlexLine Elite draw requested at 13:30 Eastern Time on a business day is funded that day, while a FlexLine Plus draw requested at the same moment is funded the next business day.
